title: Carney says Canada expects trade with PH to triple over next decade
summary: Trade between Canada and the Philippines is expected to triple over the next decade, Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney said in Manila on Saturday (November 14) ahead of the ASEAN Leaders' Summit.
